# Case schema

<!-- check: none: generated by scripts/generate_reference.py -->

This page lists every field of a case file. It is generated from the
`case_schema` field of `cfd-craft describe`, whose descriptions are the doc
comments of the Rust types. The schema dialect is JSON Schema draft-07.
Units are in the field names; see [units and conventions](units-and-conventions.md).
Tables are sorted by field name. The order in a case file does not matter.

## Case

A complete native case, schema version `cfd-craft.case/0.1`. Nothing outside the case configures the solver. Unknown fields are rejected; the lists default to empty when omitted. Deserialization checks only the types: the semantic checks (ranges, units, budgets, geometry) are those of `cfd-craft check`, which reports coded diagnostics with field paths.

Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `boundaries` | [Boundaries](#boundaries) | required |  |
| `constituents` | array of [Constituent](#constituent) | default `[]` | Passive gases transported by the flow. Default: empty, which solves the flow only. |
| `domain` | [Domain](#domain) | required |  |
| `flow` | [Flow](#flow) | required |  |
| `geometry` | array of [Block](#block) | default `[]` | Axis-aligned solid boxes (buildings, obstacles). A cell is solid when its center lies inside a box. Not allowed with `prescribed_uniform` flow (CFD-E013) or with the `multigrid` pressure preconditioner (CFD-E034). Default: empty. |
| `grid` | [GridSpec](#gridspec) | required |  |
| `initial_conditions` | array of [Initial](#initial) | default `[]` | Initial concentration fields, at most one per constituent (CFD-E018); a constituent without one starts at zero. Default: empty. |
| `moving_walls` | array of [MovingWall](#movingwall) | default `[]` | Tangentially moving `wall` faces of the domain, such as a cavity lid; laminar flow only (CFD-E021). Default: empty. |
| `name` | `string` | required | Nonempty experiment label (CFD-E002), copied into the result. It is excluded from the physics hash, so renaming keeps checkpoints compatible. |
| `numerics` | [Numerics](#numerics) | required |  |
| `output` | [Output](#output) | required |  |
| `receptors` | array of [Receptor](#receptor) | default `[]` | Named concentration samples, reported for every constituent in the result's `receptors_kg_m3` and in probes.csv. Default: empty. |
| `run` | [Run](#run) | required |  |
| `schema_version` | `string` | required | Contract version; must be `cfd-craft.case/0.1` (CFD-E001). |
| `sources` | array of [Source](#source) | default `[]` | Continuous emissions into the constituents. Default: empty. |

### Advection

Advection scheme of the constituents. `linear_upwind` is first-order upwind; it is linear in the concentrations, so responses to sources superpose exactly in a fixed flow. `muscl` adds a second-order slope with the bounded monotonized-central limiter; it is nonlinear, so superposition is not exact.

Allowed values: `linear_upwind`, `muscl`.

### Block

An axis-aligned solid box. Cells whose centers lie inside it (lower bound inclusive, upper bound exclusive) are solid; boxes may overlap. The bounds must increase on every axis and lie inside the domain (CFD-E014), and the box must contain at least one cell center (CFD-E028). Fewer than ten cells across its height draws warning CFD-W001.

Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | required | Unique nonempty ID (CFD-E014); the key of the box's cell count in geometry.json. |
| `max_m` | array of 3 `number` | required | Upper corner [x, y, z] in meters. |
| `min_m` | array of 3 `number` | required | Lower corner [x, y, z] in meters. |

### Boundaries

Boundary conditions of the domain: `x`, `y` and `z` each set the condition of the two domain faces normal to that axis (west and east, south and north, ground and top).

Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | [Boundary](#boundary) | required |  |
| `y` | [Boundary](#boundary) | required |  |
| `z` | [Boundary](#boundary) | required |  |

### Boundary

Boundary condition of the pair of domain faces normal to one axis. `periodic` identifies the two faces. `open` lets flow in or out: each face is an inlet or an outlet by the sign of the case flow's normal velocity there; inlets prescribe that velocity and a zero concentration increment, outlets fix the pressure level, and faces without normal flow are slip faces. `wall` is impermeable and no-slip (a rough wall with `neutral_rans`). `slip` is impermeable and stress-free. `ground_open_top` (z only, CFD-E005) is a rough ground with a top that applies the boundary-layer shear stress; `neutral_rans` requires it (CFD-E011) and laminar flow may not use it (CFD-E023).

Allowed values: `periodic`, `open`, `wall`, `slip`, `ground_open_top`.

### Constituent

A passive gas: transported and diffused by the flow without affecting it. Concentrations are in kg/m3.

Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `diffusivity_m2_s` | `number` | required | Molecular diffusivity in m2/s, finite and nonnegative (CFD-E015). With `neutral_rans` the turbulent diffusivity nu_t/Sc_t is added. |
| `id` | `string` | required | Unique nonempty ID (CFD-E015), referenced by sources and initial conditions and used in the result. |

### Domain

Physical extent of the domain: a box from the origin to `size_m`.

Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `size_m` | array of 3 `number` | required | Lengths along x (east), y (north) and z (up) in meters, each finite and within 1e-6..1e9 (CFD-E003). |

### Flow

Flow model, selected by `kind`: `prescribed_uniform` (a fixed uniform velocity; only the constituents are solved), `laminar` (incompressible flow with constant viscosity) or `neutral_rans` (a neutral atmospheric boundary layer with the k-epsilon model). The numeric fields are checked as CFD-E012.

#### Flow, kind prescribed_uniform

A fixed uniform velocity with no flow solve. Its normal component must be zero at impermeable boundaries (CFD-E024), and solid boxes are not allowed (CFD-E013).

Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `prescribed_uniform` | required |  |
| `velocity_m_s` | array of 3 `number` | required | Velocity [u, v, w] in m/s, finite. |

#### Flow, kind laminar

Incompressible laminar flow with constant kinematic viscosity, started from a uniform velocity.

Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `acceleration_m_s2` | array of 3 `number` | default `[0.0, 0.0, 0.0]` | Uniform body acceleration [x, y, z] in m/s2, for example the pressure-gradient drive of a periodic channel. Default: zero. |
| `initial_velocity_m_s` | array of 3 `number` | required | Uniform initial velocity [u, v, w] in m/s, finite. It also sets the velocity of `open` inlet faces and decides which open faces are inlets or outlets. |
| `kind` | `laminar` | required |  |
| `viscosity_m2_s` | `number` | required | Kinematic viscosity in m2/s, finite and positive. |

#### Flow, kind neutral_rans

Neutral atmospheric boundary layer with the k-epsilon model (C_mu 0.09, C_epsilon1 1.44, C_epsilon2 1.92, kappa 0.4). Inflow and initial fields are the logarithmic equilibrium profiles U = u*/kappa ln((z + z0)/z0), k = u*^2/sqrt(C_mu) and epsilon = u*^3/(kappa (z + z0)), with u* set by `speed_m_s` at `reference_height_m`. Requires `boundaries.z = ground_open_top` (CFD-E011).

Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `direction_deg_from` | `number` | required | Meteorological wind direction in degrees: where the wind blows from, clockwise from north. 270 blows toward +x (east), 180 toward +y (north). Finite; any value is accepted. |
| `kind` | `neutral_rans` | required |  |
| `reference_height_m` | `number` | required | Height of `speed_m_s` above the ground in meters, positive and not above the domain top. It is also the length scale of the normalized checks. |
| `roughness_m` | `number` | required | Aerodynamic roughness length z0 of the ground in meters, positive. Building and other wall faces use min(z0, 0.001 cell width), which ties that wall roughness to the grid (see the flow model card). |
| `speed_m_s` | `number` | required | Mean wind speed at `reference_height_m` in m/s, finite and positive. It is also the velocity scale of the normalized checks. |
| `turbulent_schmidt` | `number` | required | Turbulent Schmidt number Sc_t, positive: constituents diffuse with their molecular diffusivity plus nu_t / Sc_t. |
| `viscosity_m2_s` | `number` | required | Molecular kinematic viscosity in m2/s, positive; the eddy viscosity C_mu k^2/epsilon is added to it. |

### GridSpec

Uniform Cartesian grid: the cell size along an axis is the domain length divided by the cell count.

Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cells` | array of 3 `integer` (>= 0) | required | Cell counts along x, y and z: 2..4096 per axis, or 1..4096 on a periodic axis, which makes a two-dimensional run (CFD-E004). The total enters the memory estimate and may not exceed 1e8 cells (CFD-E006). |

### Initial

Initial concentration of one constituent, selected by `kind`. Each constituent has at most one (CFD-E018); without one it starts at zero. Solid cells always hold zero.

#### Initial, kind uniform

The same concentration in every fluid cell.

Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `concentration_kg_m3` | `number` | required | Concentration in kg/m3, finite and nonnegative (CFD-E025). |
| `constituent` | `string` | required | ID of the initialized constituent. |
| `kind` | `uniform` | required |  |

#### Initial, kind periodic_gaussian

A Gaussian puff, periodized over the domain, integrated per cell and scaled to exactly `total_mass_kg` of fluid mass. Needs periodic boundaries on all three axes (CFD-E026); used by the transport verification fixtures.

Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `center_m` | array of 3 `number` | required | Center [x, y, z] in meters, inside the domain. |
| `constituent` | `string` | required | ID of the initialized constituent. |
| `kind` | `periodic_gaussian` | required |  |
| `sigma_m` | array of 3 `number` | required | Standard deviations along x, y and z in meters, each positive and at most twice the domain length. |
| `total_mass_kg` | `number` | required | Mass of the puff in kg, positive. |

### Mode

Run mode. `steady` iterates in pseudo-time until every steady check passes; `run.end_time_s` does not bound it. `transient` integrates the physical interval up to `run.end_time_s`.

Allowed values: `steady`, `transient`.

### MomentumAdvection

Momentum advection on the staggered grid. Donor-cell (advective form) is the default; the others are conservative flux forms with an upwind-biased reconstruction of the transported component (van Leer's MUSCL in Sweby's notation).

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `donor_cell` | First-order donor-cell upwind in advective form (default). |
| `second_order_upwind` | Unlimited second-order upwind: face value 1.5 phi_U - 0.5 phi_UU. Not bounded. |
| `limited_upwind` | Second-order upwind with the limiter in `numerics.momentum_limiter`. |

### MomentumLimiter

Limiter of `limited_upwind` momentum advection, in Sweby's notation s(a, b) with a and b the upwind and downwind differences: `van_albada` s = ab(a + b)/(a^2 + b^2), `van_leer` s = 2ab/(a + b), or `monotonized_central` s = sign(b) min(2|a|, |a + b|/2, 2|b|). Each is zero where a and b differ in sign.

Allowed values: `van_albada`, `van_leer`, `monotonized_central`.

### MovingWall

A tangential velocity of one `wall` face of the domain, such as a cavity lid. Laminar flow only, at most one per face, and the velocity component normal to the wall must be zero (CFD-E021).

Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `axis` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | Axis normal to the wall: 0 (x), 1 (y) or 2 (z). That axis must have `wall` boundaries. |
| `upper` | `boolean` | required | True for the face at the upper end of the axis (for example z = Lz), false for the face at 0. |
| `velocity_m_s` | array of 3 `number` | required | Wall velocity [u, v, w] in m/s, finite; the component along `axis` must be zero. |

### Numerics

Discretization choices, tolerances and the steady monitor window. The optional selections `pressure_preconditioner`, `momentum_advection`, `momentum_limiter` and `steady_algorithm` are left out of the normalized case when they have their default, so cases written before they existed keep their case and physics hashes.

Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `advective_cfl_max` | `number` | required | Stability factor of explicit steps, 0 < CFL <= 0.45 (CFD-E010): with the explicit algorithm and for constituent sub-steps, dt = CFL / (sum of max\|u\|/dx + 2 D sum of 1/dx^2), D the largest viscosity or diffusivity. `implicit_viscous` applies it to advection only; `implicit_projection` uses its own CFL ramp for the flow. |
| `max_time_step_s` | `number` | required | Upper bound of the time step in seconds, finite and positive (CFD-E009). The step is the smaller of this and the stability limit; in transient mode the last step is clipped to end at `run.end_time_s`. |
| `momentum_advection` | [MomentumAdvection](#momentumadvection) | optional | Momentum advection: `donor_cell` (default), `second_order_upwind` or `limited_upwind`. Omitted from the normalized case when `donor_cell`, which keeps existing case and checkpoint hashes. |
| `momentum_limiter` | [MomentumLimiter](#momentumlimiter) or `null` | optional | Limiter of `limited_upwind`: required with it and rejected otherwise (CFD-E037). Omitted when absent. |
| `monitor_window` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | Steps per monitor window, 2..100000 (CFD-E008). A steady run assesses its checks every `monitor_window` steps and needs three full windows before `monitor_stability` can pass. |
| `pressure_max_iterations` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | PCG iteration limit of each pressure solve, nonzero (CFD-E008). Reaching it fails the step with CFD-E033. |
| `pressure_preconditioner` | [PressurePreconditioner](#pressurepreconditioner) | optional | Preconditioner of the pressure solve: `ic0` (default) or `multigrid`. Omitted from the normalized case when `ic0`, which keeps existing case and checkpoint hashes. |
| `pressure_relative_tolerance` | `number` | required | Relative residual target of each pressure solve, finite and positive (CFD-E009). A solve is accepted when the recomputed residual is within 10 times this plus 1e-12. A loose value changes the path to a steady state, not the steady checks. |
| `steady_algorithm` | [SteadyAlgorithm](#steadyalgorithm) | optional | Pseudo-time algorithm of steady runs: `explicit` (default), `implicit_viscous` (laminar only) or `implicit_projection` (laminar or `neutral_rans`). The implicit options need `run.mode = steady` (CFD-E045) and a solved flow (CFD-E047). Omitted from the normalized case when `explicit`, which keeps existing hashes. |
| `steady_monitor_tolerance` | `number` | required | Threshold of `monitor_stability`, the largest relative change between the means of three successive monitor windows; finite and positive (CFD-E009). Steady mode only. |
| `steady_residual_tolerance` | `number` | required | Threshold of the normalized steady equation residuals (momentum, turbulence and each constituent), finite and positive (CFD-E009). Steady mode only. |
| `transport` | [Advection](#advection) | required |  |

### Output

Which optional artifacts a run archive keeps, and its output budget.

Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `checkpoint` | `boolean` | required | Write checkpoint.json, a checksummed restart state. |
| `fields` | `boolean` | required | Write fields.json, the full final state including the native face velocities. |
| `max_total_mib` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | Budget for all artifacts in MiB. The preflight estimate must fit (CFD-E007); at publication, fields and checkpoint are omitted and listed in the manifest when they would exceed it (CFD-E061). |

### PressurePreconditioner

Preconditioner of the pressure PCG solve. `ic0` (the default) is an incomplete Cholesky factor built once per grid and works on every grid. `multigrid` is a fixed symmetric geometric multigrid cycle for unmasked grids only (CFD-E034); strongly anisotropic spacings select line or plane smoothing and draw warning CFD-W004. Both solve the same equation to the same tolerance and recomputed residual.

Allowed values: `ic0`, `multigrid`.

### Receptor

A named concentration sample, selected by `kind` and reported in kg/m3 for every constituent (`receptors_kg_m3` of the result, probes.csv). IDs are unique and nonempty (CFD-E019); the support is nondegenerate and inside the domain (CFD-E027) and may not sample a solid cell (CFD-E042).

#### Receptor, kind point

Trilinear interpolation between the eight surrounding cell centers, clamped at the domain boundary.

Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | required | Unique nonempty receptor ID (CFD-E019). |
| `kind` | `point` | required |  |
| `point_m` | array of 3 `number` | required | Position [x, y, z] in meters, inside the domain. |

#### Receptor, kind volume_average

The average over a box, weighted by the exact overlap of each cell with the box. Not a point sample or a peak bound.

Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | required | Unique nonempty receptor ID (CFD-E019). |
| `kind` | `volume_average` | required |  |
| `max_m` | array of 3 `number` | required | Upper corner [x, y, z] in meters; every bound above `min_m` and inside the domain. |
| `min_m` | array of 3 `number` | required | Lower corner [x, y, z] in meters. |

### Run

Mode, endpoint and execution budgets. The whole group is excluded from the physics hash, so budgets can change between a run and its restart.

Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `end_time_s` | `number` | required | Physical end time of a transient run in seconds: finite, positive and at most 1e12 (CFD-E009, CFD-E022). It does not bound a steady run. |
| `max_steps` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | Maximum number of retained steps (outer iterations with an implicit steady algorithm), counted from the cold start including the steps of a restart checkpoint; nonzero (CFD-E008). Reaching it ends the run as `iteration_limit`. |
| `memory_limit_mib` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | Memory budget in MiB for the preflight estimate (CFD-E006); a restart checkpoint may be at most half of it (CFD-E065). An estimate check, not an enforced process limit. |
| `mode` | [Mode](#mode) | required |  |
| `threads` | `integer` (>= 0) | required | Worker threads, 1..64 (CFD-E008). The CLI and the Python binding solve on a pool of this size; the Rust library does not create one. |
| `wall_time_limit_s` | `number` | required | Wall-time allowance in seconds: finite, positive and at most seven days (CFD-E009, CFD-E022). The CLI and the Python binding enforce it; a Rust caller passes it, or its own limit, to `Control::new`. |

### Source

A continuous emission into one constituent, selected by `kind`. Rates are finite and nonnegative (CFD-E016); the support is nondegenerate and inside the domain (CFD-E017). The integrated rate is distributed over the cells the support covers. Support touching a solid cell is rejected (CFD-E040), as is a steady source in a fluid region without an outlet (CFD-E043, and CFD-E020 when no boundary is open).

#### Source, kind point

A point emission, deposited in the cell that contains the point.

Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `constituent` | `string` | required | ID of the emitted constituent (CFD-E016). |
| `id` | `string` | required | Unique nonempty source ID (CFD-E016). |
| `kind` | `point` | required |  |
| `point_m` | array of 3 `number` | required | Position [x, y, z] in meters, inside the domain (each coordinate at least 0 and below the domain length). |
| `rate_kg_s` | `number` | required | Emission rate in kg/s. |

#### Source, kind line

A straight line emission. The integrated rate is `rate_kg_s_m` times the line length, distributed over the cells the segment crosses in proportion to its length in each.

Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `constituent` | `string` | required | ID of the emitted constituent (CFD-E016). |
| `from_m` | array of 3 `number` | required | Start point [x, y, z] in meters, inside the domain. |
| `id` | `string` | required | Unique nonempty source ID (CFD-E016). |
| `kind` | `line` | required |  |
| `rate_kg_s_m` | `number` | required | Emission rate per meter of line, kg/(s m). |
| `to_m` | array of 3 `number` | required | End point [x, y, z] in meters, inside the domain and different from `from_m`. |

#### Source, kind volume

A uniform emission over a box. The integrated rate is `rate_kg_s_m3` times the box volume, distributed over the cells by their exact overlap with the box.

Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `constituent` | `string` | required | ID of the emitted constituent (CFD-E016). |
| `id` | `string` | required | Unique nonempty source ID (CFD-E016). |
| `kind` | `volume` | required |  |
| `max_m` | array of 3 `number` | required | Upper corner [x, y, z] in meters; every bound above `min_m` and inside the domain. |
| `min_m` | array of 3 `number` | required | Lower corner [x, y, z] in meters. |
| `rate_kg_s_m3` | `number` | required | Emission rate per cubic meter, kg/(s m3). |

### SteadyAlgorithm

Steady pseudo-time algorithm. `explicit` is the SSPRK2 march of the earlier release. The implicit options solve for a correction driven by the full steady residual (delta form), so they share its fixed point.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `explicit` | SSPRK2 pseudo-time steps with a projection per stage, limited by advection and diffusion together (default). |
| `implicit_viscous` | SSPRK2 stages with an implicit viscous term: (I − Δτ L_ν) δ = Δτ R. |
| `implicit_projection` | One implicit correction per outer iteration, A δ = R with a Picard first-order upwind and viscous Jacobian and a CFL ramp, followed by a projection at the pseudo-time step (a SIMPLEC-type coupling). |
